metadata.content: Ballon d'Or 2026: Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal in race for men's award - stats and pundits' opinions | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Ballon d'Or 2026: Harry Kane, Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal in race for men's award - stats and pundits' opinions Harry Kane, Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe battling for 2026 men's Ballon d'Or on Monday; Kane odds-on favourite to become first Englishman to win the award in 25 years; Lamine Yamal, 19, aiming to become youngest-ever Ballon d'Or winner; Sky Sports' Jamie Carragher backing Kane to win By Declan Olley & Adam Smith Monday 26 October 2026 10:08, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Take a look at who Sky Sports pundits and journalists are backing to win the 2026 Ballon d'Or Harry Kane is the odds-on favourite to win the 2026 men’s Ballon d’Or, which could be one of the tightest results in recent history. England captain and Bayern Munich striker Kane is the bookmakers' favourite to become the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001. messages.text: Smith beats Schindler in Dortmund thriller after Littler's QF exit

metadata.summary: Ross Smith has won the Machineseeker European Championship for a second time after overcoming a late Martin Schindler fightback to claim an 11-8 victory in Dortmund.
metadata.content: European Championship Darts: Ross Smith beats Martin Schindler to Dortmund title after Luke Littler's quarter-final exit | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content European Championship Darts: Ross Smith beats Martin Schindler to Dortmund title after Luke Littler's quarter-final exit Luke Littler suffered a quarter-final exit to Krzysztof Ratajski, extending his wait for his elusive ranked TV title; Ross Smith beat Martin Schindler in the European Championship final; Watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports from November 14-22 Ali Stafford Senior Sports Journalist Sunday 25 October 2026 23:26, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Watch the winning moment from Ross Smith's European Championship success, where he closed out an 11-8 victory over Martin Schindler. (Credit: ITV) Ross Smith has won the Machineseeker European Championship for a second time after overcoming a late Martin Schindler fightback to claim an 11-8 victory in Dortmund. The 2022 champion fired a 107 average in his last-eight victory over Luke Woodhouse and rallied from 4-1 down to beat Gerwyn Price 11-7, setting up a showdown against German No 1 Schindler at Westfalenhallen. Smith edged a tight opening session before reeling off six straight legs against Schindler, who almost fell 9-2 behind before capitalising on some wayward finishing to sneak a 20-dart break of throw. Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso hit out at Williams' Alex Albon and stated the quality of drivers in the bottom third of the grid is "very low" after the pair collided at the United States Grand Prix. Albon tried to overtake Alonso for 12th place into the Turn 11 hairpin on the opening lap, but went into the side of the Aston Martin driver, damaging both cars. Neither driver received a penalty and both were able to continue with Alonso finishing 16th and Albon in 17th in Austin. messages.text: Smotherman pips Ireland's Power to play-off win in Bermuda

metadata.summary: Austin Smotherman claimed a second successive PGA Tour title after defeating Seamus Power in a play-off to win a weather-affected Butterfield Bermuda Championship.
metadata.content: Bermuda Championship: Ireland's Seamus Power misses out in Monday finish as Austin Smotherman claims PGA Tour play-off win | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Bermuda Championship: Ireland's Seamus Power misses out in Monday finish as Austin Smotherman claims PGA Tour play-off win Austin Smotherman defeated Seamus Power on the third play-off hole to claim a second PGA Tour title in as many starts; Bermuda Championship was turned into a 54-hole tournament after Sunday's play was postponed due to strong winds Monday 26 October 2026 13:09, UK Image: Austin Smotherman secured his second successive PGA Tour title Austin Smotherman claimed a second successive PGA Tour title after defeating Seamus Power in a play-off to win a weather-affected Butterfield Bermuda Championship. Smotherman and Power held a share of the 54-hole lead at Port Royal Golf Course, where Sunday's play was postponed due to strong winds before the final round was cancelled due to more poor weather. It left both players tied on 16 under and returning on Monday morning for a sudden-death play-off, with both players making par - in breezy conditions - on the first two extra holes on the par-three 16th. metadata.content: United States GP: Kimi Antonelli wins Austin race to move to brink of F1 world title after dominant drive | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content United States GP: Kimi Antonelli wins Austin race to move to brink of F1 world title after dominant drive Kimi Antonelli delivers emphatic victory in Austin to move a maximum of two points away from clinching 2026's Drivers' Championship; Antonelli only needs a ninth-place finish next Sunday in Mexico to be sure; Charles Leclerc's late surge secures second place in race from Max Verstappen Monday 26 October 2026 10:06, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the 2026 United States Grand Prix Kimi Antonelli moved to the brink of becoming Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion with a superb drive to victory in the United States Grand Prix. Antonelli had an outside chance of clinching the 2026 title as early as Sunday's Austin race provided he won, Lewis Hamilton finished outside the top four and George Russell was ninth or lower. And while he held up his side of the bargain by brilliantly claiming a ninth win of the season on a one-stop strategy to his nearest rivals' two, Hamilton took fourth and Russell eighth to stay in mathematical contention.
